# PromptBill

> LLM API Cost Calculator, Semantic Leaderboard, Head-to-Head Model Comparisons, Prompt Caching & Batch API Estimator, Context-Tiered Pricing Checker, and Multi-Host / Router Comparison at https://promptbill.online.

## Core Calculators, Matchups & Tools
- [LLM Cost & Leaderboard Workspace](https://promptbill.online/): Interactive cost calculator, 14-column benchmark grid, and Pareto frontier scatter plot.
- [Head-to-Head Model Comparisons Hub](https://promptbill.online/compare): Compare flagship, coding, reasoning, and budget LLMs side-by-side across benchmarks, 3:1 blended pricing, Elo, and speed.
- [All Models Directory](https://promptbill.online/models): Full catalog of tracked models with input, cached read, cache write, output pricing, context windows, and throughput.
- [API Pricing Reference](https://promptbill.online/pricing): Token pricing comparison across providers and tiers.
- [Routing Simulator](https://promptbill.online/tools/routing-simulator): Estimate savings from routing simple traffic to economy models and escalating complex tasks to flagship models.
- [Token Counter](https://promptbill.online/tools/token-counter): Estimate prompt token counts across providers.
- [LLM Selector](https://promptbill.online/tools/llm-selector): Match models to coding, reasoning, RAG, or high-throughput workloads.
